about: The weapons each class is meant to use (Kyle, 2026-11-18). Without Off-meta, the main weapon is one of 'intended' (Kyle: most people want to play spear with Huntress); 'close' weapons are for weapon set 2 and boss skills, or the main hand only when nothing intended makes a build unless the player picked a weapon or named a skill that needs another. 'Staff' is a caster staff, 'Quarterstaff' an attack staff (PoB: Staff / Warstaff). 'ascendancies' adds weapons for one ascendancy only. Edit freely.

Gemling Legionnaire.why: Attribute stacker: a mace in the main hand or on weapon set 2 works as well as a crossbow (Kyle).
